description: React component 'CodeBlock' for rendering syntax-highlighted code snippets with copy and download functionality, using Material-UI and react-syntax-highlighter.

classes.name: CodeBlock
classes.description: React memoized component for displaying code with syntax highlighting, copy, and download features.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies code value to clipboard and shows confirmation popover.

methods.name: downloadAsFile
methods.description: Downloads the code as a file with appropriate extension based on language.
